title: ReAugment: Model Zoo-Guided RL for Few-Shot Time Series Augmentation and Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2409.06282v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series forecasting, particularly in few-shot learning scenarios, is challenging due to the limited availability of high-quality training data. To address this, we present a pilot study on using reinforcement learning (RL) for time series data augmentation. Our method, ReAugment, tackles three critical questions: which parts of the training set should be augmented, how the augmentation should be performed, and what advantages RL brings to the process. Specifically, our approach maintains a forecasting model zoo, and by measuring prediction diversity across the models, we identify samples with higher probabilities for overfitting and use them as the anchor points for augmentation. Leveraging RL, our method adaptively transforms the overfit-prone samples into new data that not only enhances training set diversity but also directs the augmented data to target regions where the forecasting models are prone to overfitting. translated_title: ReAugment：基于模型库引导的强化学习用于少样本时间序列增强与预测
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测，特别是在少样本学习场景中，因高质量训练数据的稀缺而面临挑战。为解决此问题，我们开展了一项关于使用强化学习（RL）进行时间序列数据增强的初步研究。我们的方法ReAugment解决了三个关键问题：训练集的哪些部分应被增强、增强应如何进行，以及RL在此过程中带来哪些优势。具体而言，我们的方法维护一个预测模型库，并通过测量各模型间的预测多样性，识别出具有较高过拟合概率的样本，并将其作为增强的锚点。利用RL，我们的方法自适应地将易过拟合的样本转换为新数据，这不仅增强了训练集的多样性，还引导增强数据定向到预测模型易过拟合的区域。我们进行了验证...
tldr: 本文提出ReAugment方法，利用强化学习自适应识别易过拟合样本并定向增强，以提升少样本时间序列预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReAugment, which uses reinforcement learning to adaptively identify overfit-prone samples and perform targeted augmentation, improving few-shot time series forecasting performance.
